run_text2image_generation: run the text2images script to generate images from a caption using a pretrained stable diffusion model
build_stable_diffusion_pipeline: build a stable diffusion pipeline from pretrained components including tokenizer, text encoder, vae, and unet
generate_images_with_prompt: generate images from a text prompt using a stable diffusion pipeline with configurable guidance scale and seed
create_image_grid: create an image grid by arranging multiple PIL images into rows and columns
parse_cli_arguments: parse command-line arguments for model path, caption, image count, seed, and cuda device id
